launches.body:
TLDR: _flowscope deploys agents that learn and document how your business actually runs: who touches what, where it stalls, what's pure repetition. Our agents redesign and automate these processes, shipping AI into production on your existing systems. In days, not months._

Learn more at <https://flowscope.com>

Video Launch: <https://youtu.be/cRw55SdXirU>

**The problem**

The hard part of enterprise AI isn't the models anymore, it's deploying them against the messy reality of how businesses actually run.

Every company has the same problem: invoices re-keyed between systems, approvals chased over email, the same spreadsheet rebuilt every week. The AI tools that could fix it are stuck in proofs of concept: integration is painful, your team doesn't have the bandwidth, and the consultants you hired left you with a deck and a bill.

**What we're building**

flowscope fixes this. Our agents sit on top of your existing tools and learn how your team actually works: who touches what, where things stall, what's pure repetition. Within days, you get a map of your processes, a redesign of how the work should flow, and the automation shipped into production. Not a deck. Not a pilot. Working software on the systems you already have.

**About Us**

**Javier Leguina:** 2x founder, Founding engineer Model ML (YC W24)

**Samuel Mirpuri:** Quantum Black (AI by McKinsey), Platoon Commander Singapore Armed Forces

**Asks**

1\. Intros to CFOs or COOs at mid-market or enterprise companies with manual finance, admin or ops processes.

2\. Intros to PE operating partners working on improving operational efficiencies at portfolio companies.

Learn more at <https://flowscope.com>
